learnedRules.name: The 2.5x Morning RVOL Gate (Rule 11B)
learnedRules.discoveredAfter: AFFLE July-28 & Historical False Break Analysis
learnedRules.thesis: A stock breaking out of an NR7/VCP squeeze MUST have at least 2.5x morning RVOL (09:15 - 09:45 AM). If volume is below 2.0x, it is an 80% false break trap.
learnedRules.actionableGuardrail: Never enter unless 15-min volume pace is >= 2.5x of 20DMA baseline.

learnedRules.name: Index Confluence Guardrail (Rule 10A)
learnedRules.discoveredAfter: Failed Stock Breakouts during Index Selloffs
learnedRules.thesis: Stock breakouts cannot fight index drag. If Nifty/Bank Nifty trades below morning open or prints Bearish PCR Drift (< -0.03), do not buy Call options on stock breakouts.
learnedRules.actionableGuardrail: Abort long entries if Nifty is below morning open price.

learnedRules.name: Period C Follow-Through Filter (Rule 4E)
learnedRules.thesis: If morning breakout in Period C fails to make a new high in Period D (10:45 - 11:15 AM), exit immediately; there is an 88% probability of rotating to test the opposite range extreme.
learnedRules.actionableGuardrail: Time stop: exit at 11:00 AM if stock trades back inside morning range.
